title: Song of Solomon Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Song of Solomon 8: love strong as death, the little sister, and Solomon's vineyard at Baal Hamon.

questions.text: What does the woman wish her beloved were like, so that she could kiss him outside without being despised?
questions.explanation: She says, "Oh that you were like my brother, who nursed from the breasts of my mother!" Then she could kiss him outside and no one would despise her.

questions.text: What would she have her beloved drink in her mother's house?
questions.explanation: She says she would have him drink spiced wine, of the juice of her pomegranate.

questions.text: Who does the woman adjure not to stir up or awaken love until it so desires?
questions.explanation: She says, "I adjure you, daughters of Jerusalem, that you not stir up, nor awaken love, until it so desires."

questions.text: How does the woman come up from the wilderness?
questions.explanation: The question is asked, "Who is this who comes up from the wilderness, leaning on her beloved?"

questions.text: According to this chapter, love is as strong as what?
questions.explanation: The text says, "love is strong as death. Jealousy is as cruel as Sheol."

questions.text: What can many waters not do to love?
questions.explanation: The text says that many waters can't quench love, neither can floods drown it.

questions.text: What do the speakers say about their little sister?
questions.explanation: The speakers say, "We have a little sister. She has no breasts," and ask what they shall do for her in the day when she is to be spoken for.

questions.text: If the sister is a wall, what will they build on her?
questions.explanation: They say, "If she is a wall, we will build on her a turret of silver. If she is a door, we will enclose her with boards of cedar."

questions.text: Where did Solomon have a vineyard?
questions.explanation: The text says that Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon, which he leased out to keepers.

questions.text: In the last verse, the woman tells her beloved to come away and be like what?
questions.explanation: She says, "Come away, my beloved! Be like a gazelle or a young stag on the mountains of spices!"

answers.text: A dove in the clefts of the rock
A gazelle or a young stag
